text:
tara (People Ops): quick idea — can we make a combined birthdays + tenure calendar for the office? would help with monthly shoutouts and the sticker-run table. :tada:
sam (People Ops): love it. do you mean a single google calendar or a tiny microsite?
jess (HRBP): calendar sounds easiest. need to confirm birthday opt-in and privacy — some folks prefer month-only.
tara (People Ops): yes — month-only by default. we can store exact dates in HR, show month on public calendar.
nick (Office Ops): for the sticker-run, i've got 200 blank stickers arriving tues. we can prep a table with name cards & a "pick a sticker" station.
alex (Eng): can we also add a small "shoutout" sticky-note wall next to it? quick kudos people can write.
sam (People Ops): good call. i can set up a 30-min drop-in launch on Wednesday at 11:30. want to link to the spot-award nom form too so managers can nominate on the spot.
jess (HRBP): reminder: spot awards require a short justification + budget code. i'll paste the form fields below so Sam can add it to the poster:
```
- nominee name
- nominator name
- short reason (1-2 sentences)
- suggested award amount
- cost center
```
tara (People Ops): perfect. Sam — can you make a one-page poster with: calendar link, launch time, sticker-run deets, QR to spot-award form, and "how to opt out of birthday visibility"?
sam (People Ops): yes. i'll draft and drop into #people-ops-assets by EOD today. @kudos-bot, can you auto-post the calendar link and reminder on the launch day?
kudos-bot: scheduled post created — will ping #general at 2026-03-25 10:00 for the launch reminder.
tara (People Ops): next: budget check. we have $350 monthly culture budget left. sticker-run + small spot-awards (3x $25) fits?
jess (HRBP): 3x25 = 75 + stickers ~= 40 + poster print 15 = 130. yes still under. recommend keeping $200 buffer for ad-hoc treats.
nick (Office Ops): i'll bring some pens and a spare stapler. need a volunteer to run the sign-in — can someone cover 11:20–12:00?
alex (Eng): i can do 11:20–12:00.
tara (People Ops): thanks! one more thing — privacy copy for the poster: "We display month-only birthdays publicly. Exact dates are kept private. To opt out, email peopleops@redwood.ai." okay?
jess (HRBP): tweak: change email to peopleops@redwoodinference.com (company address).
tara (People Ops): updated. sam will include that on the poster.
sam (People Ops): poster draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/draft-poster — feedback welcome.
alex (Eng): looks clean. maybe replace confetti emoji with subtle confetti icon on print.
tara (People Ops): will finalize and send print job to Nick by EOD. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
